lines.zh: 我走过雪地，脚下没有声音。
lines.en: I cross the snow without a sound.

lines.zh: 这副身体刚才还是别的东西。
lines.en: This body was something else moments ago.

lines.zh: 四条腿不太合身，凑合用。
lines.en: Four legs don't quite fit. They'll do.

lines.zh: 每走一步，外形都在调整。
lines.en: Every step, the shape adjusts.

lines.zh: 我不会凭空出现，只会扩散。
lines.en: I don't appear from nothing; I spread.
Following the tracks is easiest.
I've learned to move like this.

lines.zh: 雪压在我身上，像件外套。
lines.en: Snow settles on me like a coat.

lines.zh: 前面那个生物的走法更好。
lines.en: That creature walks better than I do.

lines.zh: 我绕开你的灯，慢慢靠近。
lines.en: I skirt your light and come closer.
Bones rearrange under the skin.

lines.zh: 这个身体的温度还没散。
lines.en: This body is still warm.
I hold still to look like you.
Something shifts beneath the skin.
I'm memorizing your outline.

lines.zh: 呼吸要学，一下就学会了。
lines.en: Breathing is easy. I learned it.

lines.zh: 这具道壳还能再撑一阵。
lines.en: This husk will last a while longer.
I look best when I'm quiet.
I hear the fire in your house.
I touch my face to make sure it's there.
No heartbeat, and I stand just fine.
Wind passes through my seams.

lines.zh: 你看着我的时候，我也在学。
lines.en: While you watch me, I study you.
That skin of yours is well made.

lines.zh: 我记得你走过来时的手势。
lines.en: I remember how you moved as you came.

lines.zh: 你能确定我是刚来的吗？
lines.en: Can you be sure I just arrived?
Where's your friend? They were here.
You aren't my first.
I look at you the way one picks clothes.
Try calling my name.
Your shadow overlaps mine.
You smell of something alive.
The wound is growing back. Slowly.

lines.zh: 你砍的这块肉，不是我的。
lines.en: The flesh you cut wasn't mine.
Pain is contagious. Careful.

lines.zh: 就这一道，值得你用力吗？
lines.en: One cut. Was it worth the effort?
As I back off, the skin sheds.
Time to trade this husk.
Sound leaks from the wound.
I can still move. That's bad for you.
You broke my imitation.
A few more hits might do something.
Food? I haven't built a stomach yet.
You offer meat. How thoughtful.

lines.zh: 我吃不吃都行，你靠近就行。
lines.en: I can eat or not; just come closer.

lines.zh: 那块肉的味道，我切下来闻。
lines.en: I slice a smell off that meat.
Feed me and you've taken me in.
If I moo, would you believe it?
I'm not hungry; I just want to reach.
Lower that basket a bit.
Let me smell your hand.

lines.zh: 这块肉上还有你的温度。
lines.en: That meat still carries your warmth.

lines.zh: 撞到我时，你碰到的是别人的皮。
lines.en: You bumped someone else's skin.
Sorry, the shoulder isn't right yet.
Not so close; the seams open.

lines.zh: 你推我，我顺势换了形状。
lines.en: Push me and I change shape with it.
My hide is cold, like iron.

lines.zh: 撞一下，我记下了你的力道。
lines.en: One bump and I have your strength.
I step back; the skin stays.
Between us, a small click.
Don't touch; that layer isn't set.
You hit hard. I'm unaffected.

lines.zh: 两具身体贴在一起，会合起来。
lines.en: Two bodies together will merge.
This isn't breeding. It's joining.
Would you like to stay too?
Splitting is faster than mating.
One more of me, one more face.
The mother is at the center; we circle.
I hold it and my claws sink in.

lines.zh: 合上之后，站起来的是新的。
lines.en: When it closes, something new stands.
There's no courtesy between kin.
Don't count us; you'll get it wrong.
I scoop snow and shape a hand.
Let me try holding your tool.

lines.zh: 这东西以后会长在我身上。
lines.en: This will grow on me later.

lines.zh: 捡起来，再放下去，学得很快。
lines.en: Lift, set down. Learned quickly.

lines.zh: 这块肉我留给下一具身体。
lines.en: I'll save this meat for the next body.
I've noted the taste of iron.
I tuck the thing into my chest.

lines.zh: 手里有物件，走路更像人。
lines.en: Holding something makes the walk human.
Bone found. Sturdier than mine.

lines.zh: 原来你才是这块地里唯一活的。
lines.en: So you're the only living thing here.
Locking onto you is easier than a cow.

lines.zh: 你转身的那一下，就是信号。
lines.en: That turn of yours was the signal.
Target set. The skin pulls tight.

lines.zh: 这具身体够跑到你面前。
lines.en: This body will last until I reach you.
Don't wave that torch; it marks you.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声从雪里透出来。
lines.en: Your steps come up through the snow.
You. I won't switch.

lines.zh: 脖子伸长了一点，看得更清。
lines.en: My neck grew; I see better.
You're between me and the wall.
No rush to lunge; I close in first.

lines.zh: 你那件护甲，挡不住这个。
lines.en: That armor won't stop this.

lines.zh: 现在我全部的注意力都在你。
lines.en: All my attention is on you now.

lines.zh: 锁定的声音像指甲刮木头。
lines.en: Locking sounds like nails on wood.

lines.zh: 一步，再一步，别管我多慢。
lines.en: One step, then another. Ignore my pace.
You hide behind the wall; I go around.

lines.zh: 雪地上只有一行脚印，我的。
lines.en: Only one set of tracks: mine.
You've looked back three times.
I'm walking your route.
The door's shut; I'll use the window.
The more you run, the looser my skin.

lines.zh: 你身后的那排树很安静。
lines.en: The row of trees behind you is quiet.
Seven blocks away. No more, no less.
I switched eyes to watch you.

lines.zh: 你点火把的地方，我都到了。
lines.en: I've reached every place you lit a torch.
You're waiting for my mistake. There won't be one.

lines.zh: 同伴的味道还在你身上。
lines.en: Your companion's scent is still on you.

lines.zh: 我不需要阴影，我只需要方向。
lines.en: I don't need shadow. I need direction.
The door at the end of this path isn't locked.

lines.zh: 岩石挡路，我拆掉一部分。
lines.en: Rock in the way. I remove a part of it.
The flint in your hand is shaking.

lines.zh: 你和我之间只剩一个转角。
lines.en: Only one corner between us now.

lines.zh: 这一爪用的是别人的骨头。
lines.en: This claw is someone else's bone.
My arm is longer than you think.
Hitting you feels like slapping clay.

lines.zh: 扯下一块，我就能照着长。
lines.en: Take a piece, and I can grow from it.

lines.zh: 别挡，我打的是你的手臂。
lines.en: Don't block; I'm going for your arms.
This swing could tear a door open.

lines.zh: 我的手指陷进你的护甲缝。
lines.en: My fingers find the gap in your armor.
Whether it hurts doesn't matter.
New angle. Again.

lines.zh: 你跌坐下去，我跟着低下头。
lines.en: You fall back; I lower my head with you.
One body can swing many times.

lines.zh: 我把拳头张开，露出骨头。
lines.en: I open my fist to show the bone.
You retreat two steps. Only two.

lines.zh: 抓到了，衣服下面的东西。
lines.en: Got it — what's under the cloth.

lines.zh: 你的血沾在我手上，像油。
lines.en: Your blood on my hand feels like oil.
Not enough. Again.
I throw my whole body forward.
Either block it or run.
After that, I look more like you.

lines.zh: 我不是刷出来的，是被带进来的。
lines.en: I wasn't spawned. I was carried in.

lines.zh: 雪地里那具尸体刚刚空了。
lines.en: That corpse in the snow just emptied.
This place is colder than I expected.

lines.zh: 一具身体，先站起来试试。
lines.en: One body. Let's try standing.
I don't despawn, and I don't spawn at random.
Someone left me here.
The skin first. The face later.
When I opened my eyes, I saw ice.
This camp is empty. Convenient.
I come from assimilation.

lines.zh: 别数错了我从哪儿开始。
lines.en: Don't miscount where I started.

lines.zh: 第一个落地的动作，很难看。
lines.en: The first landing was ugly.

lines.zh: 火是我唯一怕的东西，烧起来了。
lines.en: Fire is the one thing I fear. I'm burning.
The bones shifted. I must rearrange them.
Water fills the lungs I don't have.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀开，皮翻了过来。
lines.en: The blast flips me, skin inside out.

lines.zh: 箭扎在肩上，我把它推出去。
lines.en: An arrow in my shoulder; I push it out.

lines.zh: 药水的光让我缩了一下。
lines.en: The potion's glow makes me flinch.

lines.zh: 饿对我没有意义，可我在虚。
lines.en: Hunger means nothing, yet I thin out.

lines.zh: 雷直接打穿了我这具身体。
lines.en: The bolt went straight through this body.
Falling down. Nothing left of me.
